accounting.rationale: Defines common blocks and the global data facility via storage association; no byte size, physical address observation or empty execution requirement.
The blocks are the language's common blocks.
Access is available through the applicable declarations and association rules, not automatic visibility of every member name.
The facility relates scopes in one complete program.
19.5.3 owns the storage-sequence abstraction.
Defines blank common by absence of a block name.
A block without a name is blank common; its properties remain qualified by8.10.2.5.

COMMON is followed by a nonempty common-block-object list, optionally preceded by a slash pair containing an optional block name. Further slash/name/list groups may follow, with or without a separating comma. Every group has an object list; R401 supplies that list's mandatory intra-list separators.
The literal statement keyword is COMMON.
The entire first slash/name group is optional.
A first slash pair may contain no name.
When the first group is present both slashes are required.
The first object list is required even for blank common.
Zero or more additional groups may follow.
A comma before each later slash group is optional.
A later group retains both slash delimiters.
A later empty slash pair denotes blank common.
Every later group also contains at least one object.

The object form is a variable-name, optionally followed by parenthesized array-spec. The explicit R903/C903 production determines the name and role. The optional parentheses specify the variable's DIMENSION attribute, subject to C8121 and C815; they do not select a subobject.
R903/C903, not an assumed R402 substitution, supplies the member.
A bare variable name is also a complete form.
The optional array declarator has an opening parenthesis.
C8121 restricts the permitted array-spec production.
The declarator closes with a parenthesis.

Whenever R877 contains an array-spec, it must be an explicit-shape-spec-list. The distinct explicit-shape-bounds-spec alternative is not licensed merely because it describes explicit shape. Eligibility, constant/specification expressions and single attribute specification remain independent.
The condition is an inline array-spec in common-block-object.
The allowed production is the R401 list of R815.
R818 is a different production and is not this list.

A given variable-name may appear only once across all COMMON object lists in one scoping unit. The count does not reset at a new block, a new statement or a blank/named boundary. Distinct scoping units and distinct local entities are not a file-wide duplicate count.
Count occurrences of the actual variable name in the lists.
Only one appearance is permitted.
All COMMON object lists in the scope participate.
3.120 and Clause19 determine the actual scope.

A COMMON object is excluded if it is a dummy argument, function result, allocatable variable, derived-type object with an allocatable ultimate component, enumeration-type object, procedure pointer, automatic data object, variable with BIND, unlimited polymorphic pointer, or coarray. The list does not prohibit every data pointer, every derived type or an enum-type object, and BIND on a common block is not BIND on its member.
The subject is the actual R877 object.
Dummy argument role is excluded.
Function result role is excluded, including a RESULT name.
An allocatable object itself is excluded.
A derived object with an allocatable ultimate component is excluded under3.30.5/7.5.1p3.
The7.6.2 enumeration type is excluded, not the7.6.1 enum type.
Procedure-pointer role is excluded.
8.3 defines the automatic-object condition.
BIND on the variable is excluded; type/block BIND is distinct.
An unlimited polymorphic pointer is excluded.
A coarray is excluded.

For a derived-type COMMON object, the type must have BIND or SEQUENCE and must have no default initialization. These are conjunctive conditions; they concern the type, not BIND on the variable or block. A type has default initialization when a direct component has component-initialization, including recursive nonpointer/nonallocatable components and initialized pointers.
The condition applies when the object is of derived type.
BIND on the type supplies one permitted alternative.
SEQUENCE supplies the other permitted alternative.
In either alternative the type has no default initialization.
7.5.4.6p8 and the direct-component definition apply.

A variable-name in a common-block-object cannot be made accessible by use association. Renaming does not remove that association. This is not a ban on using a module's COMMON members without redeclaring membership, nor a ban on a legal block-name homonym. A COMMON object-name has a different host shadowing rule from USE association.
The constrained name is the member's variable-name.
Accessibility through USE, including renaming, is the condition.
That name cannot be an R877 COMMON object.
Defines which block each object list declares; the forms are interpreted by R876 and do not create an independent empty-run effect.
Objects following a block name are members of that block.
Omitting the first block name selects blank common.
Every object in that first list has the stated membership.
A slash pair without a name also selects blank common.
The following entire list supplies blank-common objects.
Separates permission to repeat a block name from the ordered list continuation interpretation. Variable-name uniqueness remains C8122.
A block name may recur.
An omitted/blank block name may recur.
Repetition may be within one or multiple statements.
Concatenation is scoped to one scoping unit.
Later lists for the same named block continue that list.
Later blank-common lists similarly continue blank common.
Defines the inline R877 array-spec route to the existing DIMENSION attribute; no second local shape or no-op runtime requirement.
The parenthesized array-spec belongs to the variable declarator.
The attribute's semantics remain8.5.8.
It is the declared variable, not an array element, that gets DIMENSION.
Interprets numeric/character sequence objects as component entries in the COMMON list; any observed consequence retains19.5.3/19.6 definedness rules.
7.5.2.3 supplies the exact numeric sequence class.
7.5.2.3 supplies the exact character sequence class.
The qualifying object occurs in COMMON.
The components are interpreted as individually enumerated.
Their place/order is in the surrounding COMMON list.

pending.named-first-block: PENDING one complete ordinary program with separately declared default INTEGER variables and COMMON /packet/ first, second. No initializer, array re-declaration or payload reference is needed for admission.
pending.implicit-blank-first-block: PENDING the same complete scalar context with COMMON first, second and no initial slashes. The entire first list belongs to blank common.
pending.explicit-blank-block: PENDING COMMON // first, second in the same complete context. Keep empty delimiters distinct from an absent object list.
pending.optional-intergroup-comma: PENDING complete sources with two different named blocks and a blank group, distinct INTEGER members, and identical declarations. Vary only the optional comma between slash groups; both forms are valid.
pending.mandatory-intralist-separator: PENDING COMMON /packet/ first second in a complete two-variable context, repaired only by inserting the comma. No next slash group is present, so the optional intergroup separator cannot explain it.
pending.missing-object-list: PENDING a complete source with COMMON /packet/ and no member, repaired by inserting the already typed first. Separately adjudicate bare COMMON and a final empty slash group rather than treating generic EOF as their cause or creating duplicate controls.
pending.delimiter-and-double-colon-exclusions: PENDING complete sources with one missing closing slash, or COMMON :: first, repaired by restoring that slash or deleting :: respectively. Preserve eligible declarations and an actual complete END.

requirements.title: COMMON objects exclude ten specified entity and storage roles
requirements.definition: A COMMON object is excluded if it is a dummy argument, function result, allocatable variable, derived-type object with an allocatable ultimate component, enumeration-type object, procedure pointer, automatic data object, variable with BIND, unlimited polymorphic pointer, or coarray. The list does not prohibit every data pointer, every derived type or an enum-type object, and BIND on a common block is not BIND on its member.

pending.dummy-argument: PENDING a complete ordinary subroutine with a genuine typed dummy also named in COMMON and a complete caller supplying it. Delete only the COMMON statement for the control; do not use a local homonym as the negative.
pending.function-result: PENDING a complete ordinary function with an explicit RESULT(r), typed and assigned in the body, and COMMON /packet/ r. Delete only COMMON for the control; retain the function interface, result definition and caller.
pending.allocatable-variable: PENDING a scalar INTEGER,ALLOCATABLE member; remove only ALLOCATABLE for the ordinary-scalar COMMON control. Neither program needs allocation, inquiries or an undefined payload reference for compile evidence.
pending.allocatable-ultimate-component: PENDING a complete SEQUENCE type with a scalar INTEGER,ALLOCATABLE component and no initializer, plus a whole object in COMMON. Remove only ALLOCATABLE from the component declaration for the valid same-shape scalar-component type; retain the SEQUENCE attribute.
pending.recursive-ultimate-component-boundary: PENDING complete nested SEQUENCE types with an allocatable ultimate component behind a nonpointer nonallocatable derived component. A separately adjudicated pointer-hop control terminates ultimate component recursion at that pointer, with no default initializer and no pointer dereference. C745/C8124 remain gates; reachable target components are not automatically ultimate components of the containing object.
pending.enumeration-type: PENDING retain a complete7.6.2 ENUMERATION TYPE definition and TYPE(...) variable in both programs. Delete only its COMMON membership for the control. A processor unable to admit the same enumeration syntax in the control has not supplied a qualifying COMMON diagnostic.
pending.procedure-pointer: PENDING retain the complete abstract interface and PROCEDURE(iface),POINTER declaration in both sources; remove COMMON from the control. Resolve the overlap with R903/C903 rather than insisting that the processor uniquely name C8123 or substituting an ordinary procedure.
pending.automatic-data-object: PENDING complete ordinary subroutine with an INTEGER dummy n and CHARACTER(len=n) local named in COMMON; change only the local length to constant3 for the control. Keep the caller and dummy declaration; no explicit SAVE, initialization, automatic-array side defect or value read.
pending.bind-variable: PENDING a complete module with ISO_C_BINDING's C_INT and an INTEGER(C_INT),BIND(C) variable also listed in COMMON. Delete only BIND(C) from that variable for the control. A separate BIND(C)::/packet/ context is permitted only with C821/18.9 conditions and is not the same attribute.
pending.unlimited-polymorphic-pointer: PENDING complete CLASS(*),POINTER local declaration in both sources, with COMMON removed only in the control. Do not use a nonpointer polymorphic object or an undeclared class as a false control.
pending.coarray: PENDING a complete main program with an otherwise eligible explicit coarray declaration and COMMON membership; delete COMMON only for the control, retaining the coarray syntax. Any later observation needs the actual coarray capability/mode gate; no launcher or image success is assumed.
pending.ordinary-data-pointer-admission: PENDING complete INTEGER,POINTER scalar and separately deferred-shape array declarations may be named bare in COMMON. No initializer, allocation or ASSOCIATED inquiry is performed; undefined initial pointer status is not queried. C8124 and8.10.2.4p7 still apply.
pending.enum-and-block-bind-boundaries: PENDING separate fully defined7.6.1 enum-type and BIND common-block admission plans, with all actual kinds, member interoperability and same-label declarations qualified. Neither is an enumeration-type or variable-BIND exclusion. No C companion execution or physical representation test is inferred from compile admission.

requirements.definition: For a derived-type COMMON object, the type must have BIND or SEQUENCE and must have no default initialization. A type has default initialization when a direct component has component-initialization, including recursive nonpointer/nonallocatable components and initialized pointers.

pending.sequence-type-admission: PENDING a complete public SEQUENCE type with ordinary uninitialized INTEGER components and an ordinary whole object in COMMON. C745 and C8123 remain satisfied; storage expansion needs a later actual run.
pending.bind-type-admission: PENDING a complete TYPE,BIND(C) definition with uninitialized INTEGER(C_INT) components and a whole object in ordinary COMMON. The variable and block need not themselves be BIND. Qualify18.3.4 without inventing byte offsets or requiring an actual C object for admission.
pending.missing-type-attribute: PENDING the same otherwise eligible simple derived type without SEQUENCE or BIND, repaired by adding only SEQUENCE. Do not repair by supplying both attributes: C1801 forbids that combination.
pending.nonpointer-default-initialization: PENDING a SEQUENCE INTEGER component with =7 and a COMMON object of that type; delete only =7. One component suffices even if all other components lack initialization. No payload is read.
pending.pointer-default-initialization: PENDING a complete SEQUENCE type with an intrinsic INTEGER pointer component initialized =>NULL(), versus the same declaration without that initializer. The pointer ultimate component is not allocatable; undefined initial association in the control is never inquired about.
pending.nested-default-initialization: PENDING two complete nested SEQUENCE definitions with a default-initialized INTEGER behind a nonpointer nonallocatable component. Remove only that inner initializer for the control. A shallow scan of the outer declaration is not sufficient.
pending.type-object-and-initialization-boundarie: PENDING source-qualified contrasts keep type BIND, object BIND, block BIND and DATA/type-declaration explicit initialization distinct. Explicitly initializing an object does not erase its type's C8124 default-initialization condition. Pointer/allocatable hops and existing C745/C1801-C1806 owners require their own causal analysis.

requirements.title: Successive lists continue the same block within one scope
requirements.definition: Successive object lists for the same named block, or for blank common, are concatenated in one scoping unit. Repeating a block name does not reset its list. Differently scoped declarations describe associated storage views, not further text appended to this scope's object list.
requirements.oracle: Defined default-INTEGER value propagation across complete, matching COMMON views. Use independent literal tuple oracles, not addresses, emitted assembly or a same-processor serialization round trip. Every future effect requires a complete driver and all declaring/defining procedures, actual successful compile/link/run traces in the required f2023 configuration, independent literal observations and executed-call/completion checks. For named COMMON initial families, put consistent SAVE /block/ in every nonexempt declaring procedure and match the complete storage sequences; avoid relying on an accidentally active scope or implicit SAVE. Seed every observed storage unit with a known sentinel before the operation under test, so omitted-write sensitivity never reads undefined data. Keep actual arguments distinct from COMMON storage to avoid dummy-aliasing violations. Wrong-order/value/omission/omitted-call mutations must fail the whole counted parent, not a detached expression. Four complete programs and their whole-program mutations now implement exactly the four ordered-list facets named above; every other plan under this requirement remains unimplemented.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The permission to repeat block names is not a separate effect, and this does not permit a variable to recur. Same-name declarations in another scope are not appended to this list. Only the four named ordered-list facets are represented by cases; every other proposed effect under this requirement remains PENDING. Those four cases create no linked facet, SourceUse relationship, inventory renewal, source approval, baseline change or universal conformance credit. Each reference/target/configuration is separate; f2018 success cannot corroborate an f2023 expectation. Numerical-kind, real/BOZ/IEEE, coarray and companion/CFI-header gates remain with their actual owners. Missing or unsupported prerequisite evidence cannot be treated as success.

requirements.title: Qualifying sequence objects act as enumerated COMMON components
requirements.definition: Numeric sequence and character sequence objects in COMMON are interpreted as though their individual components occurred in the object list. Their exact classes come from7.5.2.3 and recursively exclude pointer/allocatable components. Ordinary derived types, mixed sequence types and BIND layouts are not silently treated as these two classes.

pending.numeric-sequence-integer-components: PENDING complete two-view program with a no-initializer SEQUENCE type containing two default-INTEGER components. The writer's COMMON contains two objects of this type; the reader's matching COMMON contains four INTEGER scalars or a size4 array. Seed and set component values11,22,33,44; assert that literal order across the entire counted program with matching saved named-block declarations.
pending.nested-numeric-sequence: PENDING complete nested SEQUENCE definitions with only nonpointer nonallocatable default-INTEGER components and an array component of constant size. Enumerate the exact ultimate scalar order independently from source and9.5.3.3, then check distinct small literal values through a matching flat COMMON view. No padding or sizeof assumption is an oracle.
pending.character-sequence-components: PENDING a complete writer type with SEQUENCE, CHARACTER(2) first and CHARACTER(3) second, and no initialization. A reader has CHARACTER(5) in the same block. Seed all five character units, assign 'AB' and 'CDE', then require 'ABCDE'. Preserve default character kind, partial-association and definition rules, equal total sequence and saved named-block contexts; wrong order or omission must be caught without a read of an undefined character.

requirements.oracle: Independent literal component/position observations in complete programs.
